basics.name: Juntao Wu
basics.label: Agent Builder & Harness Engineer
basics.summary: Computer engineering student and builder interested in coding agents, agent harnesses, distributed-systems debugging, and AI for education.

projects.name: Cirdan — Coding Agent & Distributed-Systems Debugging Benchmarks
projects.summary: Developed a coding agent for diagnosing and debugging distributed systems, and designed benchmarks to assess LLM agents' debugging capabilities.
highlights: Investigated how agent harness design and evaluation methodology influence real-world debugging performance.
Research outcome: DistDebug-Bench, accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations and Datasets Track).

projects.name: Coursify — Course Generation & Sharing Platform
projects.summary: Built a website for generating and sharing courses, combining product thinking with full-stack implementation.

projects.name: Toy Compiler
projects.summary: Implemented a compiler for a custom Snake language, covering lexical analysis, parsing, and code generation.

projects.name: Kernel Thread Implementation
projects.summary: Implemented kernel-level thread management and synchronization mechanisms, verified with formal methods.

projects.name: RISC-V Processor
projects.summary: Designed and implemented a processor datapath and control logic. The source resume describes this as RISC-V supporting ARM ISA; clarify the ISA before publishing a more detailed write-up.
